text:
The defendant who knowingly let his extremely inebriated friend drive his car is the one most likely guilty of murder. Knowing the friend was extremely drunk and still allowing her to drive shows a conscious disregard of a grave risk of death, which can support depraved-heart or implied-malice murder. The homeowner whose gun a burglar later steals and uses in a killing has no such malice, and the burglar’s independent crime breaks causation.

CONFIDENCE: 84
